title: Vietnamese Chicken Ca Kho To
description: A peppery and juicy Vietnamese dish featuring chicken cooked in a tagine pot, perfect for a brunch mood. This recipe is jain-friendly and uses buttermilk and bhuna spices.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together buttermilk, bhuna spice mix, black pepper, and salt.
Add the chicken pieces to the bowl and mix well to coat, then cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in the tagine pot over medium heat.
Remove the chicken from the marinade, letting any excess liquid drip off, and add to the pot.
Cook the chicken until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes, then remove from the pot and set aside.
In the same pot, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil, then add the sliced onions and cook until they are lightly browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the pot and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the chopped scallions to the pot and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the cooked chicken back to the pot, then add the fish sauce if using, and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 10-15 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce has thickened.
